title: Uesugi-kun Wants to Quit Being a Girl
titleEnglish: Uesugi-kun Wants to Quit Being a Girl
titleNative: 上杉くんは女の子をやめたい
synonyms: Uesugi-kun wants to quit being a girl
synopsis: In this gender-bending rom-com manga, one young man's wish for love will change him—literally! Uesugi Keisuke has always struggled with being short and adorable compared to his super smart and tall best friend. One day, he overhears his crush comment, "Wouldn't he be the cutest if he was a girl?!" This makes him worry she doesn't even see him as a guy. Down in the dumps, he prays at the shrine next to his house in the hopes that he can still achieve young love. However, it seems there was a major misunderstanding, because when his prayer is answered, he winds up transformed into a girl! Thus begins Uesugi's gender-bent love triangle! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synopsis: "Don’t you think it’s stupid to be so madly in love?" Princess Letitia is due to be executed by guillotine, for the terrible crimes she committed trying to win back her fiancee's love. However, just when she thought she was dead, she was returned back in time for a second chance at life. "I won’t fall in love in my new life. I’m going to live peacefully by becoming a sober, hard-working student with glasses!” But one day, her glasses slip off and Camilo, the school's superstar, sees her true face. Then, for some reason, Camilo begins to dote on her in a tidal wave of affection…!? (Source: Comic Days, translated)

The two met in their childhood and spent happy times together as best friends. Until the difference in their races separated them. Kagura took up the sword for Raito. To "live together" in order to do so, the bond between the two that transcends years transcends walls, races, and reality!! A Japanese-Western mixed fantasy with overwhelming brushwork that will rush out into the world! The start of this story!! (Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

synopsis: Alban realizes that he had been reincarnated as the “villainous nobleman” of a fantasy novel. Just as he starts rigorously training in sword and sorcery so that he would not be defeated by the hero, Alban finds out that Leticia, the daughter of the villain, is to be his bride! Leticia is a young lady who is the subject of many unsavory rumors! He was scared to see what kind of “bad girl” she would be… But when he meets her, she seems pure and beautiful as an angel, almost like his ideal woman. Alban is so smitten that he forgets all about his plan to avoid the bad ending. He decides to strike back at the mastermind behind his beloved wife's downfall! Using their own villainous reputation to their advantage, he sets a trap to lure out the culprit......? (Source: Corona EX, translated)

synopsis: Van, the fourth son of a powerful noble, is only two years old when he remembers his past life as a salaryman in Japan. With his adult brain in a young body, he’s considered a child prodigy…until he displays the “Production Magic” skill when he turns eight. In a family that favors offensive magic, this crafting skill is considered useless in battle, and Van is banished to oversee a tiny country town in disgrace. With only his personal maid, the memories of his past life, and his “worthless” magic, can Van improve the fortunes of this little village—and himself? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synopsis: The story begins with Snow White, who fell asleep after eating a poisonous apple, waking up in modern-day Japan. After wandering the streets of the city, she arrives at Kabukicho, where she is called out to by a woman named Karen. Karen also seems to come from a fairy tale world, just like Snow White, and the two hit it off. However, one day, after going to meet the "prince," Karen's behavior becomes strange... In order to return to her original world, Snow White unites with "princesses" from other worlds, such as Cinderella, and struggles to activate magic. (Source: Natalie, translated)
